article_content: In Istanbul, renowned Turkish singer and actor Ibrahim Tatlises was critically wounded on Monday after unknown attackers shot him in the head early in the morning, as reported by his doctor on television. Tatlises, who enjoys immense popularity across Turkey and the Middle East, sustained a bullet wound to the right side of his brain and underwent immediate surgery, according to Dr. Ilhan Elmaci from Acibadem Hospital. The incident occurred as Tatlises and his spokeswoman, Buket Cakici, were leaving the premises of Beyaz TV after his weekly show. Cakici is reported to be in stable condition. Tatlises, aged 59, hails from the predominantly Kurdish southeastern province of Sanliurfa in Turkey. Apart from his entertainment career, he is a successful businessman with interests in restaurants, music production, television, and tourism. He has also been involved in construction projects in northern Iraq. Known affectionately as 'Emperor' and 'Ibo,' Tatlises has released over 30 albums and has acted in and directed more than a dozen films. Despite lacking formal education, he once humorously remarked, 'If there had been an Oxford in Sanliurfa, I would have gone there.' Tatlises reached the pinnacle of his career in the 1980s, acting in numerous films and directing several of them, as documented by the Internet Movie Database. Contributions to this report were made by CNN's Talia Kayali.

article_content: (CNN) -- In 1948, a new word entered the vocabulary of South Africans, destined to symbolize racial oppression worldwide. That word was apartheid, used to describe a policy of segregation and discrimination aimed at keeping blacks and whites separate in every aspect of life. The Afrikaner-dominated National Party had won a narrow election victory in 1948 and used the word apartheid in a policy statement to describe its segregation program. The policy divided the South African population into four distinct racial groups -- white, African, colored, and Asian -- and a multitude of laws were passed to institutionalize the apartheid system. The Population Registration Act required all South Africans to register with the government according to their race. Interracial sex and marriage were prohibited, and each racial group was required to live separately. Other laws segregated South Africans in buses, taxis, trains, hotels, restaurants, and waiting rooms. The Communist Party was also outlawed, and the government defined membership so broadly it could arrest people indiscriminately, branding them Communists. Nelson Mandela, who died at age 95 after years of health ailments, was born in 1918 in a South Africa where segregation of black and white was already on the statutes. The son of a tribal chief, he grew up in a rural community in Eastern Cape where the color of his skin designated him a second-class citizen under law. Blacks had subpar job opportunities. In the years following the creation of the Union of South Africa in 1910, legislation came into force making it a criminal offense for blacks to break a labor contract and restricting them to unskilled or semi-skilled jobs. The Natives Land Act of 1913 separated South Africa into areas in which either blacks or whites could own land. Blacks, constituting two-thirds of the population, were restricted to 7.5% of the land. Whites, making up one-fifth of the population, were given 92.5%. It took Mandela a lifetime of struggle, including 27 years in prison, to overturn legislation that denied Africans basic freedoms enjoyed by the descendants of white European colonists. A man who played a major part in transforming apartheid from an election slogan into an adopted practice was Hendrick Verwoerd, a senator in 1948 and prime minister in 1958. He was assassinated in 1966 by a colored parliamentary messenger and was succeeded by John Vorster, who as minister of justice had orchestrated the government's campaign to crush internal resistance. Several measures were taken in the 1960s to put the theory of apartheid into practice. Under the provisions of the Group Areas Act, urban and rural areas in South Africa were divided into zones in which members of only one racial group could live, and all others had to move out. In practice, it was blacks that had to move, often under threat or use of force. Between 1963 and 1985, approximately 3.5 million blacks were sent to the homelands, where they added to the already critical problem of overpopulation. Most of the homelands were economic and political disasters. By the late 1970s, the National Party began to believe that reforms should be introduced to appease domestic and international critics. In 1978 Pieter W. Botha, Vorster's successor, and his administration applied a mixture of carrots and sticks. It repealed bans on interracial sex and marriage, desegregated many hotels, restaurants, buses, and trains, and removed the reservation of skilled jobs for whites. But the Botha reforms stopped short of making any real change in the distribution of power, and black resistance continued. In 1983, Botha's government proposed that political power be shared among whites, coloreds, and Indians, with separate houses of parliament for each racial group. This proposal caused angry opposition within the National Party and 16 members were expelled. But a new constitution came into place in 1984, with P.W. Botha as the first state president. Most blacks strongly condemned the new constitution. Rather than viewing it as a major step towards reform, they saw it as another step to bolster apartheid. In January 1986, Botha shocked conservatives in the all-white House of Assembly with the statement that South Africa had 'outgrown the outdated concept of apartheid.' Botha suffered a stroke in 1989 and resigned as party leader. F.W. de Klerk was elected to succeed him for a five-year term. De Klerk recognized the urgent need to bring the black majority into the political process, and most party moderates agreed with him in principle. But he surprised his supporters by announcing, on February 2, 1990, the impending release of Nelson Mandela, who walked to freedom nine days later at the age of 71. De Klerk continued reforms by rapidly repealing a number of laws first introduced to bolster the apartheid system, and the irreversible progress towards democracy had begun. By the end of 1993, Mandela, de Klerk, and the leaders of 18 other parties endorsed a new interim constitution to take effect immediately after South Africa's first election of universal suffrage. Under this constitution, all citizens over 18 were enfranchised, the homelands abolished, and the country was divided into nine new provinces. On April 27, 1994, the first elections open to all South African citizens were held, and Nelson Mandela was subsequently unanimously elected president by the new parliament. Mandela introduced housing, education, and economic development initiatives designed to improve the living standards of blacks. He established the Truth and Reconciliation Commission to investigate human rights abuses during apartheid, and in 1996 he oversaw the enactment of a new democratic constitution. After a landslide ANC victory in 1999, he handed over the leadership responsibilities to Thabo Mbeki.
translated_content: (CNN) -- A shekara 1948, kalma na biyo akan maganar South Africans, ya yiwu domin ya zama alamar hanyar tsirarsa ta duniya. Wannan kalma na biyo ne apartheid, wanda aka shafawa da shi don bayyana kokarin kokarin gargajiya da kokarin tsohuwar da ke nufin cikin dukkanin rayuwa. Na farkon farko, Afrikaner-dominated National Party ya ci gaba ga kokarin kokarin gargajiya a shekarar 1948, kuma ya shafawa da kalmar apartheid a cikin wani bayani game da kokarin gargajiya. An yi wa jama'ar South Africa cikin wanda ke mutane na farko a kan hukumomi da suka kai tsakanin su, amma suka gabatar da cutar kokarin gargajiya da kokarin tsohuwar. Hukumar Population Registration Act ya bukata domin dama masu zabi hukumar gwamnati ta hanyar tsirarsa da su. An haramta juna da kuma auren juna, kuma kowane mutane suna bukatar da su yayin da suke. Wasu hukumomi sun gargada South Africans a cikin basi, taksi, trene, ashe, asusu da gidan zabe. Hukumomin Communist Party ya yiwu, kuma gwamnati ya bayyana zaben da shi kamar yadda ya iya karba mutane har su ba su da wani lokaci, suka kira su Communists. Nelson Mandela, wanda ya mutu a shekaru 95 da yawan cuta, ya woofi a shekaru 1918 a cikin wani South Africa wanda ke tsirarsa da kowa ne bayan kwado da kasa. Yaran wannan sarakunan ya isa ya kasance a cikin jam'iyya na yanki a Eastern Cape inda rangun farin sa ya sanya shi daga cikin hanyar tsirarsa ta hukumar. Masu kowa suna da sha'awar aikin da ya fi dangi. A yanzu daga duba wani Union of South Africa a shekaru 1910, an samar da cutar hukumar wanda ya haramta domin dama masu kowa da suka rarraba wani aikin da kuma suka kashe su har su ba su da wani aikin mai kyau kawai. Hukumar Natives Land Act ya gabatar da South Africa a matsayin makomai wanda zasu iya kwanciyar kasa kawai. Masu kowa wanda suke da shawara da jama'a suka kasance a cikin 7.5% daga kasa. Masu farko wanda suka da shawara da jama'a suka samu 92.5%. Ya bukata minista Mandela wanda ya ciyar da wanda ya yi da hukumomin da suka kashe masu kowa daga karamin zabe na mutane masu zazzage ta turai. Wanda ya gabatar da apartheid daga kalmar da aka shafawa da shi ga kokarin gargajiya ga kokarin gargajiya ne Hendrick Verwoerd, senator a shekaru 1948 kuma shugaban a shekaru 1958. An kashe shi a shekaru 1966 da wani majidadin parliyamenti mai kyau, kuma John Vorster ya samu makoma daga cikin wanda ya kuma shugaban hukunci ya gabatar da kokarin gargajiya da gwamnati don kashe tsohuwar a cikin ciki. A shekaru 1960, an yi ko da ya kamata don samun kokarin gargajiya a cikin amfani. A cikin cikakken hukumar Group Areas Act, an gabatar da South Africa a matsayin makomai wanda ke mutane na farko zasu iya zama kawai, kuma dama suka fitar da cikin wani lokaci. A amfani, na mutane da suka biyo ne suka fitar da kyau, ko da aikin tsoro ko kuma amfani da kishi. Daga shekaru 1963 zuwa 1985, takwas 3.5 milyon mutane da suka biyo suka je musamman makomai, wanda suka gabatar da cutar wani iyaka da zazzage. Duk makomai suka kasance ko da kyau ko kuma da siyasa. A watan nan guda, daga wannan lokacin da suka samu wani bambanci, na farkon farko ya kamata wanda zasu iya samun bambancin da ke taimaka ko da jama'ar da ke taimaka musamman makomai. A shekaru 1978 Pieter W. Botha, makoma daga cikin Vorster, kuma gwamnatinsa suka yi amfani da wadannan abubuwan da ke cikin ciki da abin da ya fi dangi. Ya kare bangaren wani aure da kuma auren juna, ya gabatar da dukkan ashe da trene, kuma ya fitar da hanyar tsirarsa da aikin da ya fi dangi ga masu farko. Amma an bambanci da canje-canjen hanyar tsirarsa ta hanyar mulki, kuma tsohuwar ta mutane da suka biyo suka dawo. A shekaru 1983, gwamnati na Botha ya bayyana wanda zasu iya haifar da mulki a kan mutane da masu farko da kuma mutane masu hannu, da makomai da ke taimaka musamman parliyamenti ga kowane mutane. Wannan bayani ya sa ta wurin wanda zasu iya haifar da mulki a cikin na farkon farko, kuma hakan 16 mutane suka fitar daga cikin wani lokaci. Amma wani dustum hukumar ya samu a shekaru 1984, da P.W. Botha daga shugaban kasa. Dukkan mutane da suka biyo suka karkata wannan dustum hukumar. Ba su rage wani canje-canjen ga cewa ya zama wani gabatarwa ga bambanci, suka samun ta daga cikin wannan lokacin. A wannan ranar na biyu ga watan January 1986, Botha ya sa mutane masu kyau a cikin gida majalisar da ke cikin farko da wani bayani wanda South Africa ta fita daga fahimtar da zamanin apartheid. Botha ya kashe takwas a shekaru 1989 kuma ya fitar daga makamarsa. F.W. de Klerk ya zama makoma ga mudu biyu da shekara. De Klerk ya san wani zato game da kowa ya dauki jama'ar da suka da zazzage a cikin amfani da siyasa, kuma dama masu kyau daga cikin na farkon farko suka dawo da shi a cikin amfani. Amma ya sa masu taimakon da suka rage shi da wani bayani a ranar na biyu ga watan February 2, 1990, cewa ana juyar da Nelson Mandela, wanda ya fitar daga cikin cikakki a cikin sata, a shekaru 71. De Klerk ya gabatar da canje-canjen hukumomi da suka samun daga cikin amfani da kokarin gargajiya da kokarin gargajiya, kuma ana cikin canje-canjen ga jamhuriyyar ta dauki. A wannan lokacin guda, Mandela, de Klerk, kuma masu neman 18 wanda suka dace, suka dauki wani dustum hukumar don samun amfani daga bayan kimar hukumar. A cikin wannan hukumar, dama jama'a daga shekara 18 zasu iya kula da kyakkyawar hukumar, an kare makomai, kuma an gabatar da kasa a cikin tara da kasa da suka samu. A ranar na tallace 27 ga watan April 1994, an yi tallace wa jama'ar South Africa daga cikin farko, kuma Nelson Mandela a lokuta ya zama shugaban kasa na gwamnati. Mandela ya samar da abubuwan da ke taimaka rufe da kula da abinci don cancantar daidaita tsakanin mutane da suka biyo. Ya samun takardar Zaben Annobi don biyu matsala ta hanyoyin abokan adam a cikin apartheid, kuma a shekaru 1996 ya gabata wani dustum hukumar mai jamhuriyyar. Bayan kimar kyakkyawar kasa a shekaru 1999, ya fitar da mulkin hukumar ga Thabo Mbeki.

article_content: A remote abattoir in Romania has been identified as a primary source of horse meat found in European supermarkets. The Doly-Com slaughterhouse, located in the small village of Roma in northeast Romania, openly processes hundreds, if not thousands, of horses annually. The plant, which employs about 20% of the village’s 1,000 residents, features a large billboard showing a grazing horse beside a cow. Romanian authorities have pinpointed Doly-Com and another firm, CarmOlimp in Brasov, Transylvania, as sources of horse meat that was fraudulently labeled as beef. Speculation suggests that some of the horse meat discovered in supermarkets across Europe might actually be donkey meat. A recent change in Romanian law, enforcing stricter road rules, has led to a decrease in the use of horses and donkeys for traditional cart transport, resulting in many being sent to slaughter. This has raised concerns that meat contaminated with horse and donkey, found in France, Sweden, and Britain, may include donkey meat. Romanian Agriculture Minister Daniel Constantin confirmed that the exported horse meat originated from the two abattoirs but denied any involvement in mislabeling. Iulian Cazacut, the general director of Doly-Com, admitted to purchasing horses from various sources for slaughter but insisted that all meat was correctly labeled and recorded. CarmOlimp, owned by the father of a junior Romanian agriculture minister, also denied mislabeling horse meat as beef. The complex supply chain, involving multiple traders and countries, has made tracing the meat’s origin challenging, allowing horse meat to be sold as beef in frozen meals across Europe. Meat from Romania, which exports £10 million of horse meat annually, was initially sold to a Dutch trader fulfilling an order for a Cypriot entrepreneur. The meat then passed through a French firm, Spanghero, which supplies Comigel, the company producing meals for Findus and Tesco in Luxembourg. Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ponta asserted that no breach of European rules occurred in Romania and expressed anger over suggestions of Romanian involvement in the fraud. Horse-drawn carts remain common in rural Romania, and the abattoir in Roma continues to dominate the local economy, employing a significant portion of the village’s population.

Makamai Rumaniya sun nuna kasar marmari Doly-Com da wani kasar, CarmOlimp a Brasov, Transylvania, cikin wadannan asashen kayan doki da aka saka shi akan naman jakuna. Wani tsarin sanya kanuni a Rumaniya, wanda ya sa maganganu game da kayan doki da doki da suka tafi kasar marmari, ya sa abokin dogon Yurup ya yi la'akari da kayan doki da doki a cikin naman da aka samo a Fransa, Swiden da Britain. Wadanda suka biyo naman daga Rumaniya, wadanda suka fitar da shekara biyar da naman kayan doki kawai, suka biyo wani bashi na Olanda wanda ya biya amfanin wani mutum daga Saiprus. Naman nan da ya dauki a cikin firamare ta Fransa, Spanghero, wanda ke maganar abokan naman da suka tattara abubuwan da aka biya wa Findus da Tesco a Luxembourg. Shugaban Rumaniya, Victor Ponta, ya kira cewa babu wani harshen kanuni daga Yurup da aka yi a Rumaniya kuma ya yi la'akari game da abin da ke cikin shawararwa. article_content: England's autumn international rugby matches will continue to be broadcast by Sky Sports under a new five-year agreement with the Rugby Football Union (RFU). The deal begins in July 2015 and runs through the end of the 2019-20 season. A key feature of this agreement is the QBE Series, which takes place annually at Twickenham in November. The contract also includes England's World Cup warm-up matches against France and Ireland in August and September of next year. Additional coverage encompasses England's annual spring fixture, matches involving the England women's team, and games from the Greene King IPA Championship. Sophie Goldschmidt, the RFU's chief commercial and marketing officer, expressed enthusiasm about the continued partnership with Sky Sports. She highlighted the chance to showcase England's teams effectively and to strengthen grassroots rugby, thereby benefiting the entire sport.

Wani yaki ya shafi takardun tashin wasu gwagwarmayar Ingila daga ne ga tsakanin Dunia a ga tsakanin watan Agusta da watan Satumba daga yanzu har yanzu. Wasu tambayoyin da suka biyo shine takardun wasu gwagwarmayar Ingila a kowane shekara, wasu gwagwarmayar mata Ingila, da wasu wasanni daga cikin Greene King IPA Championship. article_content: A four-year-old boy who tragically died after accidentally shooting himself in the chest has been identified by police. Roderick Paige, of Plaza Court in Mobile, Alabama, passed away after firing the shot on Easter Sunday following a church service. His parents rushed him to USA Children and Women's Hospital in Prichard, where he was pronounced dead. The child and his family had just left church and were visiting relatives when the tragic incident occurred. An investigation into the child's death is ongoing, with officers questioning the child's relatives. This marks the second time in two weeks that a young child has accidentally shot themselves in the U.S. On March 20, another four-year-old boy shot himself in the head at a condo in Orange County and was taken to the hospital in stable but critical condition.

article_content: By John Drayton  The England squad enjoyed a lively encounter with a Brazilian youngster who predicted a '2-1' score and performed a samba dance as they traveled through Rio de Janeiro on Tuesday. The enthusiastic youngster held up his fingers, clearly indicating his score prediction for England's match against Uruguay on Thursday, before breaking into a samba dance beside the team's coach. Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain shared the moment on his official Facebook page, writing: 'On the coach today on the way back from training... Have a look at this cheerful kid telling us the score and then pulling out the FIFA samba celebration at the end!!' Oxlade-Chamberlain seemed to enjoy the youngster's banter and will no doubt be in high spirits after completing his first full training session since suffering a knee injury on Monday. He had heavy strapping on his right knee and broke off from training with the rest of the group after around fifteen minutes to do some individual work as he builds his way back to full fitness. Roy Hodgson will be hoping he can call upon Oxlade-Chamberlain sooner rather than later as England faces World Cup elimination if they lose to Uruguay on Thursday night. All in good fun: Oxlade-Chamberlain seemed to enjoy the youngster's banter. Over another hurdle: Oxlade-Chamberlain took part in his first full training session on Monday. Easy does it: The fitness of the Arsenal youngster will be a huge boost to England's squad.

article_content: By Nicole Mowbray. PUBLISHED: 17:35 EST, 5 June 2013. UPDATED: 11:42 EST, 11 June 2013. Posh Spice has long been making fashionistas envious. Who could fail to be jealous of her jet-set lifestyle, her beautiful family, or her burgeoning fashion empire? But the newly discovered medical condition Poshitis is not a malady caused by excessive jealousy but the name experts have given to a real physical problem — muscle strain caused by carrying heavy bags. Experts are blaming the A-list’s favored 'Arm-Hook Crook' (AHC) — the trend for carrying an oversized weighty handbag on a bent elbow — for a rise in the number of women suffering shoulder problems, torn muscles, and inflamed tendons. Big is best: Victoria Beckham photographed out and about with her gargantuan white Hermes Birkin bag. And I’m ashamed to say, I’m one of them. Earlier this year, I purchased a gorgeous new designer bag. Although it was, in the words of Stella Artois, 'reassuringly expensive', it wasn’t the price tag that left me wincing. Made by luxury French fashion house Celine, my new tote is heavy-duty leather and full of useful pockets that fasten with several chunky zips. It’s got extra flaps and reinforced straps and metal studs on the bottom so it doesn’t get ruined if you put it down on the floor (but as it cost more than my first car, this is something I never do). Despite its equally hefty price tag, the handle is too small to fit over my shoulder, so, of course, I do the whole 'arm hook crook' thing. Yet since I bought my Celine bag, I’ve had a relapse of an earlier jumbo handbag-related ailment — sporadic but severe bouts of shoulder pain that radiate down into the pectoral muscle on my chest. It’s unsurprising then, that oversized totes are not only loved by the style set but by osteopaths, chiropractors, and physiotherapists, too, as handbag-related injuries are boosting their bank balances. I first felt my 'handbag injury' almost four years ago when I noticed a sharp pain in my right shoulder. But because I’d had a car accident a few years earlier that left me with a cracked sternum and damaged muscles in my upper back and around my collarbone, I put it down to a flare-up of that. Love: Beckham is famous for her passion for big bags, although it's one the fashion world shares. Ouch: Sadly for big bag fans, carrying them around can lead to painful injuries to the arms and shoulders. Then, after a few weeks of nagging twinges, I went to see a physiotherapist who, after taking one look at my overloaded Mulberry bag, promptly sent me to fashion purgatory by telling me to go home via Millets and invest in a Karrimor backpack. 'The kind worn by hikers' he said. 'Make sure you get one with padded straps and wear it on both shoulders.' I didn’t, nay, couldn’t! But I found the bag’s abandoned shoulder strap from the depths of my wardrobe and stopped carrying the equivalent of four bricks in it. Briefly, my symptoms abated. Several years later, fashion’s love affair with the large handbag is not only going strong, it’s got stronger. Hermes Birkin bags are more popular than ever, Mulberry’s new Willow is rather substantial. Then there’s Phillip Lim’s latest number, the 31 Hour leather tote and Alexander McQueen’s Heroine handbag. My Celine model is called the 'Luggage'. It’s a fitting moniker for something that currently houses my iPad, iPhone, BlackBerry, complete make-up bag, pair of flat shoes, a diary, a notebook, my keys, two pens, a bottle of water, several hairbands, and various assorted lip balms. 'We have seen a huge increase in women with shoulder and neck problems caused by handbags,' said physiotherapist Sammy Margo, who also says some patients are lugging around bags weighing one-and-a-half stone. 'Women may think they are following a catwalk trend, but they are storing up trouble.' Perhaps so, but when it comes to bags, women know that size does matter. Celebrities may favor large bags to make them look smaller, but most women simply carry them out of necessity. It’s that, or a small bag accompanied by two linen shopping bags full of everything a modern girl needs, swinging from your shoulders. Bags of damage: If women like Mollie King, Cheryl Cole, and Millie Mackintosh copy Victoria and carry their bags in the crook of their elbow, they could face torn muscles and inflamed shoulder tendons. Model approval: Exclusive gym Bodyism trains Elle Macpherson (left) and Rosie Huntingdon-Whiteley (right). Having flirted with a mini Mulberry shoulder bag throughout winter (it could barely fit my purse and a lipstick, meaning keys were left languishing precariously in my pocket) and an envelope-style snakeskin clutch bag throughout spring (it gave me hand cramp and I eventually left it under a chair) there was no option but to big-up my bag again. This is not something Michael Tanner, Performance Specialist at London’s exclusive Bodyism (the gym beloved by celebrities such as Elle Macpherson and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley) approves of. 'Carrying a heavy bag has many postural effects on the body,' says Michael. 'It not only pulls down the shoulder, which can put constant strain on the neck muscles, but our bodies naturally lean away from the side on which we’re holding a weight — in this case a bag. This leaning leads to a tightening of the opposite side of the neck, as well as throwing your shoulders, hips, knees, and ankles out of alignment. Don’t even get me started on high heels,' he adds. Oops. I daren’t tell Michael what I am wearing today. But if I had to make a choice between the two fashion evils, I know which I’d choose. And let’s just say I won’t be hotfooting it to Millets anytime soon.
